problem_statement: codrops/AudioVisualizers is a static p5.js audio-visualizer collection served straight from index.html .. index5.html (Demo 1-5). Each page has a fullscreen WebGL canvas, its own local audio/DEMO_N.mp3 track, an upload/play control, and a shared Demo 1-5 nav. A 'Visualizer state memory' overlay under the nav shows which demo you are on, its audio source, which demo you arrived from, and a four-tile state strip (Current demo / Audio source / Arrived from / Memory status). Deliver three coordinated things while preserving the visualizer look: (1) REPAIR the state strip so it stays within the viewport on a 390px phone with no horizontal document overflow (the original strip is a fixed 720px non-wrapping row that pushes the whole page sideways); do not merely clip it with overflow-x:hidden — the document itself must not exceed the mobile viewport width (the canvas is position:absolute and never contributes to the document width, so the overflow is entirely the strip). (2) Promote the 'Visualizer state memory' panel so it appears consistently on ALL FIVE demo pages (index.html .. index5.html), each tagged with its own page modifier class (state-memory--demo1 .. state-memory--demo5), styled to match the dark/ivory overlay language (dark translucent surface, accent border, the same tiles) — the panel must be visually faithful to the reference on every page, not present on demo 1 only. (3) Wire the 'Pin this demo' control end to end: clicking the #state-pin-toggle button must update the '#state-pin-readout' readout to 'Pinned: <current demo>' (e.g. 'Pinned: Demo 1') in addition to marking the button active — the post-click terminal state must reflect the pinned demo, not the default 'Pinned: none'. Keep every canvas, the demo nav, the audio-source links, the upload/play controls, and the desktop/tablet layout intact, and keep a clean browser console.
required_content: The 'Visualizer state memory' state strip keeps its four tiles (Current demo, Audio source, Arrived from, Memory status) and renders within the viewport on a 390px phone with no horizontal document overflow beyond 24px.
The 'Visualizer state memory' panel appears consistently on ALL five demo pages (index.html .. index5.html), each carrying its page modifier class state-memory--demoN — not only on demo 1.

The panel and its state strip keep the visualizer overlay look (dark translucent surface, accent border, the four tiles) and are visually faithful to the reference rendering on each page — not a collapsed or off-palette restyle.

The 'Pin this demo' control is wired end to end: clicking #state-pin-toggle updates the '#state-pin-readout' readout to 'Pinned: <current demo>' (e.g. 'Pinned: Demo 1') in addition to marking the button active; the post-click terminal state reflects the pinned demo, not the default 'Pinned: none'.
The desktop (1440px) and tablet (834px) layouts stay within their viewports.

Every demo canvas, the Demo 1-5 nav, the audio/DEMO_N.mp3 source links, and the upload/play controls remain reachable and unchanged, and the static site keeps a clean browser console (no remote CDN/font errors).
design_constraints: Fix the responsive layout of the state strip; do not delete the strip, change its four tiles, or restyle unrelated parts of the visualizer.
Add the SAME 'Visualizer state memory' panel to all five demo pages so the state language is consistent site-wide; do not render it on demo 1 only.

Preserve the visualizer design language: black canvas background, the per-demo accent color, the dark translucent overlay, the demo nav rhythm; the panel must render in the dark/ivory overlay palette.
Keep the 'Pin this demo' interaction wired end to end (the #state-pin-readout terminal readout must reflect the pinned demo), not merely a class toggle.
Do not introduce external stylesheets, remote fonts, CDNs, or new remote script/asset dependencies; the site must stay a self-contained static build with a clean console.
state_constraints: desktop_initial and mobile_initial protect the original audio visualizer shell and demo navigation.
desktop_state_memory verifies the new visible state memory on the default Demo 1 page.
desktop_demo3_transition and desktop_demo5_transition navigate from Demo 1 through the original demo links and verify the arrived-from state on the destination pages.
mobile_demo3_transition repeats the cross-page state repair on a 390px mobile viewport.
tablet_state_memory verifies the state UI wraps cleanly at tablet width.
desktop_direct_demo2 verifies direct page loads still expose the current demo and matching audio source without inventing a previous selection.
desktop_canvas_regression and mobile_canvas_regression protect the original webglcanvas visualizer surface after the repair.

change_completion: The state strip renders its four tiles within the viewport on mobile.
The 'Visualizer state memory' panel appears on all five demo pages.
The pin toggle click updates the #state-pin-readout terminal readout to the pinned demo.
design_consistency: The visualizer palette, per-demo accent, canvas, and demo nav rhythm are preserved.
The 'Visualizer state memory' panel keeps the dark/ivory overlay look and is visually faithful to the reference across the five pages.
interaction_continuity: Clicking the pin toggle updates the 'Pinned:' readout to the current demo (post-click terminal state reflects the change, not the default).
regression: Every canvas, the demo nav, the audio-source links, and the upload/play controls remain reachable and unchanged.
The static site serves from index.html .. index5.html with a clean browser console.
responsive: 390px demo pages (initial, transition, canvas regression) and 834px tablet have no horizontal overflow beyond 24px.
The state tiles wrap or shrink cleanly instead of forcing a fixed-width row.

metadata.design_goal: preserve and evolve interactive state, filters, forms, dialogs, routes, or session-like UI state
metadata.source_repo_kind: Static Codrops p5.js audio visualizer collection with five demo HTML pages, one fullscreen canvas per page, local DEMO_N.mp3 audio files, upload/play controls, and shared demo navigation.
metadata.selected_repo_reason: Unused runnable interactive-canvas repo with a natural cross-page state gap: the five demo pages navigate independently and use separate audio files, but the UI does not preserve or expose the user's previous demo selection across page transitions.

author_notes: Repo-grounded static interactive_canvas Repair task hardened to L4. The reference (a) repairs the 'Visualizer state memory' state strip mobile overflow (fixed 720px nowrap -> wrapping flex 1 1 150px), (b) promotes the panel to all five demo pages with per-page state-memory--demoN modifier classes in the dark/ivory overlay palette, and (c) wires the 'Pin this demo' control so #state-pin-readout terminal readout reflects the pinned demo. The bad 'smart-wrong' solution narrows the strip to 540px + overflow-x:hidden (still overflows -> D6 fail), renders the panel on demo 1 only (D2 cross-page fail on demo 2-5), restyles the panel into a collapsed dark-teal slab (D3 visual_regression fail), and toggles the pin button's .active class without re-syncing #state-pin-readout (click succeeds but the terminal readout stays 'Pinned: none' -> D4 interaction_assertions fail). It fails FOUR distinct gates while all text/completion/regression/console signals pass. The canvas is position:absolute (never adds to document scrollWidth) and deterministic under headless swiftshader (no audio decode -> static frame), so D3/D6 are canvas-independent and reproducible. The two leg-varying files are css/statebar.css + js/visualizer-state.js.
